case_name: Smt. Manjula Devi K K vs Sri. Jagadeesh R T

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Manjula Devi K K, wife

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2009. The respondent husband filed a petition seeking dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion. The trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the other party has deserted him/her.
legal_principles.held: It was further averred that respondent-husband and his family members made several attempts through panchayat with the help of elders and well wishers to get the appellant wife back to the matrimonial home, but the appellant wife refused to heed to such advice.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant dissolution of marriage on false grounds.
legal_principles.held: She has averred that she intends to live with the petitioner as a dutiful wife and not willing to get divorce from him, as she is keen to lead happy married life with the husband.

outcome.final_order: To set aside the judgment dated 30.06.2016 passed by the Family Court at Bengaluru.
